chunks: And from him, from Hammad, from Shu'ayb, from Abu Basir, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): that he was asked about the day that is made up from the month of Ramadan, so he said:

"Do not make it up (fast) unless two just witnesses establish from all the people of prayer when the beginning of the month was," and he said, "Do not fast that day which is made up unless the people of the districts make it up; if they do, then fast it."
ai.seo_question: How to determine and fast the missed day of Ramadan when the month's length is uncertain?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes a dual mechanism for resolving uncertainty regarding the length of Ramadan, emphasizing the importance of communal verification through two just witnesses or the consensus of local authorities (ahl al-amṣār). This ruling highlights the Shia jurisprudential balance between individual testimony and collective authority in determining the start and end of lunar months, ensuring uniformity in worship across different regions.
